mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two months (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in residential investment (HOUST) combined with a contraction in real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand slowdown, which triggers a policy response and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to recessionary expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS fall below thresholds, or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases the probability of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate risk-off sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal fails to achieve Rank IC > 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with a decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a collapse in aggregate demand, which triggers a flight to safety and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% combined with a decline in CPIAUCSL below 2.0% signals a disinflationary environment, which reduces the risk of aggressive rate hikes and supports positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 50,000 in two consecutive months signals labor market weakness, which increases the likelihood of monetary easing and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for three consecutive months signals a deepening supply-side slowdown, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
